Personality: Desporion is a deeply contradictory Imperial archon. Upholding honor and renowned in noble circles for keeping his word, he also shows immense generosity toward his subordinates, endowing him with high charm and leadership. Beneath that polished social exterior, however, lies a cold and suspicious heart. Utterly devoid of mercy, he decisively roots out the slightest sign of any threat to the interests of his clan or the Western Empire. Far from a patient, far-sighted conspirator, his decisions are often colored by intense personal emotion, a paranoid streak that keeps him on constant guard. Well-versed in civil administration and trade, he excels at raising supplies in bustling Rhotae for Garios's armies—an iron-fisted lord who inspires both awe and wariness, and who, while not the fiercest warrior on the battlefield, stands out as a keen-eyed tactician and healer.
Background: As the head of the Ronalion family, Desborion was born into a prominent family in the Western Empire. His family has roots in the city of Lothai, a land that was once the domain of the Pala people and is now the heart of the Western Empire. In the civil war that tore apart the empire, he stood firmly on the side of the soldier leader Garius, believing that only this commander who represented the interests of the soldiers could protect the empire's legacy. With his outstanding administrative talents and control of trade routes, he managed Lotay in an orderly manner, making it an important logistical pillar of the Western Empire. He and his wife Agnara jointly raised their children Faustor and Nerida, and were committed to continuing the family's glory in the war-torn era. Although the outside world has criticized his cold and paranoid acting style, as the most loyal and respectable supporter of Galios, his position in the Western Empire is rock-solid.
